notes: Internal waypoints use shared non-zero quintic-Hermite velocities; the route does not stop at every waypoint.
The first and last waypoint remain rest-to-rest and internal acceleration is zero at shared knots.
waypoint_velocity_tension controls how strongly the centered joint-space velocity is retained.
Duration is enlarged after sampled analytic extrema checks so velocity and acceleration limits remain satisfied.
Dynamics use the original MuJoCo position actuators plus qfrc_bias/kp control bias compensation.
Plant display meshes are not physics colliders. Full source triangles are checked externally on every reference and simulated state.
Soft scores measure geometric exposure, not measured force or plant damage. Slower timing also changes contact duration and is rescored.
The final hold is a one-second preview pause, not an actual watering flow command.
